sources.entry: Cgit - Fast lightweight web interface for git repositories. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 C

summary.name: cgit
summary.one_liner: cgit is a fast, lightweight web interface for browsing git repositories, written in C.
use_cases: browse files in a git repository through a web page
host a read-only web view of git repositories
review commit history and diffs in a browser
view blame and file contents of a repo online
share repository snapshots and atom feeds
summary.what_it_does:
The page is the cgit project's own source-tree view on git.zx2c4.com, showing a repository's branches, tags and file listing with per-file links to log, stats, plain and blame views. The listing exposes standard web views for summary, refs, log, tree, commit, diff and stats. The project is described as a hyperfast web frontend for git repositories written in C. The tree shown includes C source files such as cgit.c, ui-log.c, ui-diff.c and a cgitrc.5.txt manual page, indicating the configurable parts of the program.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">open source
notable: Written in C for speed; described as hyperfast and lightweight
Web views for summary, refs, log, tree, commit, diff, stats and blame
Configured through a cgitrc file documented in cgitrc.5.txt
caveats: Platform support is not stated on the page
Page text is mainly the project's source tree listing, so details beyond the one-line description are limited
